rule: Shared learning cannot keep compounding unless a quality dashboard shows accepted lessons, improved recommendations, reverted lessons, blocked routes, stale signals, pending reviews, and the next quality action.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, payment-custody signal, tenant-private memory, or unaudited lesson can improve learning quality scores in phase one.
quality_principles: Measure learning quality before increasing recommendation confidence.
Separate accepted lessons from pending, stale, reverted, and blocked lessons.
Show whether recommendations improved after an exchanged lesson applied.
Keep reverted lessons visible so operators can see what the system corrected.
Track blocked payment-custody routes as quality protection, not lost revenue.
Require human review for weak, contradictory, or low-sample lessons.
Give each role one next quality action before learning weights compound again.

role_quality_dashboards.next_quality_action: raise proof freshness weight only after review
send freshness nudge before lifting visibility
hold scale until response quality improves

acceptance: Marketplace shows the Learning Quality Dashboard after the Exchange Policy Audit Log.
Buyer, supplier, and founder views each show accepted, improved, reverted, blocked, stale, pending review, and next quality action.
Copy output explains quality state, audit source, improved recommendation, rollback, review, and blocked payment route.
Build Phase shows the v173 Learning Quality Dashboard contract after the Exchange Policy Audit Log contract.
Docs include quality states, quality routes, private routes, blocked payment routes, and required quality fields.
Static check fails if the dashboard UI, contract, JSON model, cache-bust token, or render functions are missing.
No shared learning can keep compounding without quality visibility in phase one.
